newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Delhaize sees 100 Thai stores in 5 years.
newsitem.headline: Delhaize sees 100 Thai stores in 5 years.

text.p: Belgian retailer Delhaize "Le Lion" SA said on Monday its Thai supermarket chain venture aimed to have three stores in the first year, 10 in the second year and over 100 stores in five years' time.
Delhaize will take a 45 percent stake in supermarket chain Bel-Thai Supermarket Co Ltd, local firm the Mall Group will take 45 percent and Saha Group 10 percent.
"Delhaize is starting (the venture) slowly, then developing and accelerating," Delhaize's Chief Financial Officer Jean-Claude Coppieters told Reuters. He gave no estimate of sales for the new chain.
